t: Spoken to a whole cemetery at once
a: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ
p: As-salāmu ʿalaykum dāra qawmin mu'minīn, wa innā in shā' Allāhu bikum lāḥiqūn.
m: Peace be upon you, dwelling of a believing people. And we will, if Allah wills, be joining you.
